# <span id="aanchor3"></span> Exception Directory

[&lt;&lt; Back](../Exception%20Directory.md) \| <a href="#" class="selected">0 - 99</a> \| [100](100-199.md) \| [200](200-299.md) \| [300](300-399.md) \| [400](400-499.md)

## 0 - 79

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />0 System constants not available for this period</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00000">

This exception is most often created when the system encounters a gap in time in the [System Factors](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Factors.md) form while performing calculations.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 622;height: 359;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1 Event old value does not match previous event new value</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00001">

This exception will be generated when the system identifies unmatched old and new values while importing a CFX file.

For example: The following CO<sub>2</sub> events are imported:

| Event | Old Value | New Value |
|:-----:|:---------:|:---------:|
|  \#1  |  12.4983  |   12.4    |
|  \#2  |  12.505   |  12.506   |

In this case, an exception is generated because the Event \#2 old value does not match the Event \#1 new value.  FLOWCAL expected the Event \#2 old value to equal 12.505.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 637;height: 530;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2 Unknown transaction type</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00002">

This exception is generated from the transaction queue if FLOWCAL receives a transaction type that does not correspond with the following known transaction types:

| Number | Transaction Type                                        |
|:------:|:--------------------------------------------------------|
|   1    | Meter Event - Instantaneous & Static Meter Transactions |
|   2    | Meter Alarm                                             |
|   3    | Meter History - Periodic Measurement Transaction        |
|   4    | Meter Configuration Snapshot                            |
|   5    | GQ Gas Quality - Periodic Gas Quality Transaction       |
|   6    | GQ Event - Instantaneous & Static GQ Transactions       |
|   7    | GQ Snapshot                                             |
|   10   | Meter Ultrasonic Data                                   |

 

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4 Meter identified in transaction failed to load</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00004">

This exception is generated if data was loading for a meter and the transaction queue service or the FLOWCAL database lost connectivity. It could also be triggered by a meter that is locked by another user.

</div>

#### 6 Failed reasonable test (deprecated)

#### 8 Data received for out-of-service meter (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00009">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9 Characteristic or analysis changed without corresponding event</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00009">

This exception is generated when FLOWCAL receives data but does not have an event that matches the change in value.

For example: If a liquid meter has a product of propane on the meter for all of the time, but the product is changed to butane through an import and there is not an event corresponding to the product change, this exception will be generated. This indicates that the user is not receiving events from their flow computer.

</div>

#### 10 Meter number does not exist (deprecated)

#### 18 Required value too low (deprecated)

#### 19 Volume not given; will attempt to calculate it (deprecated)

#### 20 Volume present but no differential pressure (deprecated)

#### 22 Volume present but no pulses (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00024">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />24 Temperature base out of range</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00024">

This exception is generated for a meter characteristic record that has a temperature base value that is less than or equal to -100 or greater than 1000.

</div>

#### 26 Pipe diameter out of range (deprecated)

#### 29 Orifice out of beta (small) (deprecated)

#### 31 Orifice out of beta (large) (deprecated)

#### 32 Fixed factor too small (deprecated)

#### 33 Extreme relative density (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00034">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />34 Pressure base out of range</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00034">

This exception is generated when the pressure base identified in the Meter Characteristics form is out of range. FLOWCAL uses a 12-16.1 (psi) hard-coded value for its pressure bases. Common triggers for this exception are base pressure values outside of the 12-16.1 range or incorrect pressure units. (See: [Unit Assignment](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/Unit%20Assignment.md))

</div>

#### 35 Viscosity out of range using 6.9e-6 (deprecated)

#### 36 Analysis is not available for this period (deprecated)

#### 37 Specific heat ratio out of range using 1.3 (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00038">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />38 AGA-8 detail Fpv calculation has incomplete analysis</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00038">

This exception applies to imported and edited Gas Flow Data when the Meter is Configured with a FPV Method of AGA-8 Detail.

If the meter analysis on a flow data record has mole % values totaling anything other than 100%, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### 40 Nitrogen (N2) is out of range (deprecated)

#### 41 Total analysis composition is not within range (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00045">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />45 Unable to close data (meter has unresolved exceptions)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00045">

This exception is generated when FLOWCAL attempts to close a meter manually or via service and the meter has unresolved exceptions. To close the meter, the exceptions must be addressed in the Exception Resolver.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00046">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />46 Unable to close data (meter has missing data)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00046">

This exception is generated when FLOWCAL attempts to close a meter with missing data, and the "Do Not Close if Missing Data" option is enabled in [System Configuration](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Configuration/System%20Configuration.md).

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00047">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />47 Unable to close data (meter held from closing)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00047">

This exception is generated when FLOWCAL attempts to close a meter that meets the requirements to be closed (no missing data or unresolved exceptions), but is being held from closing, often due to pending exceptions. (See: Exception 50)



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 566;height: 349;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00048">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />48 Auto estimated data replaced (import create revision)</a>

<div class="exception" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00048">

This exception is generated when a meter has been configured for auto estimates and the ‘Log Exception on Replacing Auto Estimate’ and the ‘Replace Estimated Data on Import’ options are enabled within the Auto Estimate tab of the Meter Editor. Data that has been auto estimated will be overwritten as data is imported and the exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00049">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />49 Missing or inhibited analysis; used prior data</a>

<div class="exception" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00049">

This exception is generated when a Quality Source Assignment has been configured with the ‘Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited’ option enabled. As quality source analysis is imported or edited, that data is validated. If an exception is encountered, the record will become inhibited and the prior analysis record will be applied as configured in the Quality Source Assignment.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00050">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />50 Unable to close data (meter has pending exceptions)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00050">

This exception is generated when FLOWCAL attempts to close a meter with pending exceptions and the "Do Not Close if Pending Exceptions" option is enabled in [System Configuration](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Configuration/System%20Configuration.md).

</div>

#### 51 Invalid exception number (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00052">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />52 Purged all data; keep original</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00052">

This exception is generated when a meter purge is initiated using the "All Date/Time" date range and the "Keep Original Data" option.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 555;height: 246;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00053">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />53 Purged all data</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00053">

This exception is generated when a meter purged is initiated using the "All Date/Time" date range. 



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 556;height: 246;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00054">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />54 HAS_RTD is different than USE_RTD</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00054">

Total Flow flow computers have two flags: "HAS_RTD" and "USE_RTD". When a probe is connected to the computer, it registers with the "Has_RTD" flag, but the technician must manually enable the “Use_RTD” option, or the manual value will be used.

This is a validation to check for a probe that is connected but not in use. This can be found in the CFX format on offset 426 and 427 for configuration. When these two values do not match the exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00055">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />55 Source assignment missing</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00055">

This exception is generated for a gas meter that does not have a source assignment set up when the Source Assignments Required option in System Configuration is enabled. This exception is generated when the meter is saved in the Meter Editor with the First Flow date of the meter entered in the Misc. tab; the exception will be effective as of the First Flow date. This exception is automatically resolved when an assignment is created.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00056">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />56 Default source assigned</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00056">

This exception is generated for a gas meter upon apply of a GQ source that has been set as a default analysis, with the Source Assignments Required option in System Configuration enabled. This exception is generated for the effective date of the GQ assignment. (See: [Default Analysis](../../../Source%20Analysis/Gas%20Quality%20Source%20Editor/Main%20Tab.md#DefaultAnalysis))

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00057">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />57 Purged all data; keep original</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00057">

This exception is generated when a liquid or gas quality source purge is initiated using the "All Date/Time" date range and the "Keep Original Data" option. FLOWCAL will keep the original imported values but purge any manually entered data or edits to original data. (See: [Purge Source Analysis](../../../Tools/Purge/Purge%20Source%20Analysis%20Data.md))



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00058">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />58 Purged all data</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00058">

This exception is generated when a liquid or gas quality source purge is initiated using the "All Date/Time" date range. (See: [Purge Source Analysis](../../../Tools/Purge/Purge%20Source%20Analysis%20Data.md))



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00059">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />59 Discrepancy in full wellstream usage between meter and source</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00059">

This exception is generated for a gas meter upon apply of a GQ source through an assignment. Upon analysis apply, if the meter characteristic and the source analysis record that is applied do not agree on whether full wellstream factor is used, this exception is generated on the meter characteristic record. Full wellstream usage is indicated on the Meter tab of the characteristic detail of Volume Editor for a meter, and on the Liq. Content tab for a GQ source analysis record. (See: [Full Wellstream Factor](../../../Source%20Analysis/Gas%20Quality%20Source%20Editor/Full%20Wellstream%20Factor.md))

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00060">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60 Data point value does not equal the difference between starting and ending index</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00060">

This exception is generated when the difference between the end index and start index of a value does not equal the value that is imported. For example: If a flow computer reads 1 as a start index and 11 for the end index, FLOWCAL (or the flow computer) will calculate the flow as 1. If a flow value other than 1 is imported, FLOWCAL will generate this exception.

<td style="text-align: center; border-top-style: solid; border-top-width: 0px; border-bottom-style: solid; border-bottom-width: 0px; background-color: #ffffff; border-left-style: solid; border-left-width: 1px; border-left-color: #c0c0c0; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px;"><p>12</p></td>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00061">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />61 Source record marked as "inhibited"</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00061">

This exception is generated when a sample is missing and the "Use Prior when Current is Missing or Inhibited" option is enabled (Source Assignments). The sample time frame that is missing will generate an exception for the first time frame it would have been applied to the meter.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00062">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />62 Missing source analysis; all or part of the data within the date range used prior analysis</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00062">

This exception is generated for a meter periodic record if:

- There is no applicable GQ source analysis record specified in the "Apply GQ At" option on the Assignment editor; and
- The "Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited" option is enabled (Setup \> Source Analysis \> Quality Source Assignment Viewer).

For example: the "Apply GQ At" option is set to "Effective Date/Time" on an assignment between a gas meter and an hourly chromatograph GQ, and the "Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited" option is enabled.

The GQ contains three analysis records (note that the 14:00:00 record is missing):

|     |  Effective Date   | Effective End Date |
|:---:|:-----------------:|:------------------:|
|  A  | 1/1/2016 12:00:00 | 1/1/2016 13:00:00  |
|  B  | 1/1/2016 13:00:00 | 1/1/2016 14:00:00  |
|  C  | 1/1/2016 15:00:00 | 1/1/2016 16:00:00  |

The GQ analysis records are applied to the meter as follows:

| Meter Periodic Record Effective Date | Applied Analysis |
|:------------------------------------:|:----------------:|
|          1/1/2016 12:00:00           |        A         |
|          1/1/2016 13:00:00           |        B         |
|          1/1/2016 14:00:00           |        B         |
|          1/1/2016 15:00:00           |        C         |

The exception is generated on the meter periodic record at 1/1/2016 14:00:00.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00063">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />63 Inhibited source analysis; all or part of the data within the date range used prior analysis</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00063">

This exception is generated for a gas meter upon apply of a GQ source through an assignment. Upon analysis apply, if the analysis record on the assigned GQ that is applicable to a meter periodic record according to the Apply GQ At option on the Assignment editor is inhibited and as a result no analysis is applied to the meter periodic record, this exception is generated on the meter periodic record. This is applicable only is the User Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibition option on the Quality Source Assignment editor (Setup \> Source Analysis \> Quality Source Assignment Viewer \> *select a gas meter and a record*) is unchecked.

For example, the Apply GQ At option is set to Effective Date/Time on an assignment between a gas meter and an hourly chromatograph GQ, and the Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited option is unchecked. The GQ has following analysis records:

|     |  Effective Date   | Effective End Date |   Note    |
|:---:|:-----------------:|--------------------|:---------:|
|  A  | 1/1/2016 12:00:00 | 1/1/2016 13:00:00  |    \-     |
|  B  | 1/1/2016 13:00:00 | 1/1/2016 14:00:00  | Inhibited |
|  C  | 1/1/2016 14:00:00 | 1/1/2016 15:00:00  |    \-     |

GQ analysis records are applied to the meter as follows:

| Meter Periodic Record Effective Date | Applied Analysis |
|:------------------------------------:|:----------------:|
|          1/1/2016 12:00:00           |        A         |
|          1/1/2016 13:00:00           |   No Analysis    |
|          1/1/2016 14:00:00           |        C         |

Then this exception is generated on the meter periodic record at 1/1/2016 13:00:00.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00064">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />64 Inhibited analysis; used prior data</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00064">

This exception is generated for a gas meter upon apply of a GQ source through an assignment. When setting up the assignment on the Quality Source Assignment editor (Setup \> Source Analysis \> Quality Source Assignment Viewer \> *select a gas meter and a record*), the Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited option is checked. Upon analysis apply, if the analysis record on the assigned GQ that is applicable to a meter periodic record according to the Apply GQ At option on the Assignment editor is inhibited and a prior analysis record is applied instead per this option, this exception is generated on the meter periodic record.

For example, the Apply GQ At option is set to Effective Date/Time on an assignment between a gas meter and an hourly chromatograph GQ, and the Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited option is checked. The GQ has following analysis records:

|     |  Effective Date   | Effective End Date |   Note    |
|:---:|:-----------------:|--------------------|:---------:|
|  A  | 1/1/2016 12:00:00 | 1/1/2016 13:00:00  |    \-     |
|  B  | 1/1/2016 13:00:00 | 1/1/2016 14:00:00  | Inhibited |
|  C  | 1/1/2016 14:00:00 | 1/1/2016 15:00:00  |    \-     |

GQ analysis records are applied to the meter as follows:

| Meter Periodic Record Effective Date | Applied Analysis |
|:------------------------------------:|:----------------:|
|          1/1/2016 12:00:00           |        A         |
|          1/1/2016 13:00:00           |        A         |
|          1/1/2016 14:00:00           |        C         |

Then this exception is generated on the meter periodic record at 1/1/2016 13:00:00.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00065">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />65 Missing analysis</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00065">

This exception is generated for a gas meter upon apply of a GQ source through an assignment. When setting up the assignment on the Quality Source Assignment editor (Setup \> Source Analysis \> Quality Source Assignment Viewer \> *select a gas meter and a record*), the Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited option is unchecked. Upon analysis apply, if there is no analysis record on the assigned GQ that is applicable to a meter periodic record according to the Apply GQ At option on the Assignment editor, this exception is generated on the meter periodic record. 

For example, the Apply GQ At option is set to Effective Date/Time on an assignment between a gas meter and an hourly chromatograph GQ, and the Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited option is unchecked. The GQ has following analysis records:

|     |  Effective Date   | Effective End Date |
|:---:|:-----------------:|:------------------:|
|  A  | 1/1/2016 12:00:00 | 1/1/2016 13:00:00  |
|  B  | 1/1/2016 13:00:00 | 1/1/2016 14:00:00  |
|  C  | 1/1/2016 15:00:00 | 1/1/2016 16:00:00  |

The GQ analysis records are applied to the meter as follows:

| Meter Periodic Record Effective Date | Applied Analysis |
|:------------------------------------:|:----------------:|
|          1/1/2016 12:00:00           |        A         |
|          1/1/2016 13:00:00           |        B         |
|          1/1/2016 14:00:00           |   No Analysis    |
|          1/1/2016 15:00:00           |        C         |

The exception is generated on the meter periodic record at 1/1/2016 14:00:00.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00066">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />66 Percent/unit minimum exceeded</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00066">

This exception has severity of 0 and hence disabled by default. Adjust the severity of this exception before use in the Exception Description Editor (Settings \> Settings Manager \> Exception Description).

This exception is generated for a meter when the Calibration Adjustment Apply service applies a TESTit test report to a meter and the difference between the volume or energy values before and after the adjustment is greater than the values entered in the Min Cal Adj Pct field or the Min Cal Adj Unit Diff field for the test report in the Review Test Report editor (Tools \> Review Test Report).

For example, for a test report, the Min Cal Adj Pct value is 1 and the Min Cal Adj Unit Diff is 1. Before the test report is applied to the meter, volume is 136.597 and energy is 147.917. After the test report is applied, the volume becomes 138.113 and the energy becomes 14403.377. Then the differences in volume and energy are as follows:

|        |            Percent Difference             |      Unit Difference      |
|:------:|:-----------------------------------------:|:-------------------------:|
| Volume | (137.535 / 136.597 – 1) \* 100 = 0.6867 % | 137.535 – 136.597 = 0.938 |
| Energy | (148.932 / 147.917 – 1) \* 100 = 0.6862 % | 148.932 – 147.917 = 1.015 |

Percent differences for both volume energy are less than 1 % Min Cal Adj Pct value. Unit difference for volume is less than 1 Min Cal Adj Unit Diff, but the energy unit difference is greater than 1. Therefore this exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00067">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />67 Unable to close data (meter has unaccepted auto estimates)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00067">

This exception is generated when a meter cannot be closed because there is auto estimated data within the month that have not been accepted. The autoestimated data has to be accepted from the context menu in the Volume Editor, or by using the Toolbox before the month can be closed for the meter.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00068">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />68 GPA 2172 - Incomplete analysis sample</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00068">

This exception is generated on a gas meter with GPA 2172 adjustment enabled when a meter analysis record has the component total mole % that falls outside of the system limits set in System Factors (Admin \> System Options \> System Factors). For example, Component Totals \[Hi Limit\] is set to 100.10 and Component Totals \[Lo Limit\] is set to 99.90. A meter analysis record has the following component mole %:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 391;height: 333;" />

Since the total mole % is 99.88 which is less than the Lo Limit of 99.90, this exception is generated and the GPA 2172 adjustment does not go forward.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00069">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />69 GPA 2172 - Failed to calculate relative density</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00069">

This exception is generated on a gas meter with GPA 2172 adjustment enabled when relative density cannot be calculated due to HC Properties calculation failures. For example, if an error is experienced while loading the DLL for the HC Properties calculation, this exception would be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00070">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />70 No correlation factor; unable to apply source analysis</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00070">

This exception is generated on a gas meter periodic record upon apply of a GQ source through an assignment. If the Recalc. Method on the assignment (Setup \> Source Analysis \> Quality Source Assignment Viewer) is set to Volume so that the analysis apply process would need VCF for calculation and a meter periodic record does not have a VCF, the recalculation process necessary to apply the source analysis cannot proceed and this exception is generated.

For example, an assignment between an orifice meter and a GQ source is set up with Recalc. Method of Volume. User enters temperature and pressure data into a blank periodic record manually, expecting FLOWCAL to calculate volume using the assigned source analysis. The Recalc. option in the Volume Editor for the periodic record edit is set to Vol Use VCF. Since there is no VCF on this periodic record, the calculation does not go forward and this exception is generated. 

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00071">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />71 No correlation factor; unable to calculate volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00071">

This exception is generated on a gas meter periodic record when a calculation of the record takes place if the calculation process is configured to use VCF stored in the database for the record and the record does not have a VCF.

For example, user enters temperature and pressure data into a blank periodic record and full analysis data into the associated meter analysis record manually, expecting FLOWCAL to calculate volume using the assigned source analysis. The Recalc. option in the Volume Editor for the periodic record edit is set to Vol Use VCF. Since there is no VCF on this periodic record, the calculation does not go forward and this exception is generated. 

This exception only generates for gas meters configured with the AGA-3 2013 or AGA-7 calculation method.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00072">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />72 Partially saturated sample has no H2O mol% or water content</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00072">

This exception is generated on a gas meter with GPA 2172 adjustment enabled when a meter analysis record has no value for water mole % with the Flowing Gas Condition set to Partially Saturated @ Flowing Conditions on the GPA 2172 tab in the Volume Editor. If the Reporting Condition on the GPA 2172 tab is set to Dry, as the process continues, 0 will be calculated for water mole %, which resolves the exception.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00073">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />73 Meter indicated volume exceeds line fill volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00073">

This exception is generated during the import of a line fill liquid meter if the indicated volume on the import record is greater than the line fill volume set in the meter characteristic.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00074">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />74 Unable to close meter (batches not finalized)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00074">

This exception is generated when an unfinalized batch is available when attempting to close, and the "Allow Preliminary Tickets" option is enabled.

This option allows meters and tickets to be finalized before they are closed.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00075">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />75 Number of periodic revisions has exceeded the limit specified</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00075">

This exception is generated when the number of revisions to the Meter Periodic table exceeds a specified limit, in order to notify users of abnormally high numbers of record revisions. The default alarm limit is 20, but this can be altered using the revision_limit_meter_periodic FcDebugOption.

To enable the FcDebugOption, paste the following into the FcDebugOption.cfg file and enter an alarm limit:

revision_limit_meter_periodic = 20

Once a single periodic record exceeds the number of revisions specified, the exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00076">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />76 Number of characteristic revisions has exceeded the limit specified</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00076">

This exception is generated when the number of revisions to the Meter Characteristic table exceeds a specified limit, in order to notify users of abnormally high numbers of record revisions. The default alarm limit is 10, but this can be altered using the revision_limit_meter_characteristic FcDebugOption.

To enable the FcDebugOption, paste the following into the FcDebugOption.cfg file and enter an alarm limit:

revision_limit_meter_characteristic = 10

Once a single characteristic record exceeds the number of revisions specified, the exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00077">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />77 Number of analysis revisions has exceeded the limit specified</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00077">

This exception is generated when the number of revisions to the Meter Analysis table exceeds a specified limit, in order to notify users of abnormally high numbers of record revisions. The default alarm limit is 10, but this can be altered using the revision_limit_meter_analysis FcDebugOption.

To enable the FcDebugOption, paste the following into the FcDebugOption.cfg file and enter an alarm limit:

revision_limit_meter_analysis = 10

Once a single analysis record exceeds the number of revisions specified, the exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00078">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />78 Unable to close data (meter has unprocessed live oil queue entries)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00078">

This exception is generated when a user attempts to close a dead oil or flash gas meter if there are unprocessed entries in the live oil queue for the given meter and close month. To close the meter, please wait for the entries to process.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00079">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />79 Import meter number does not match FLOWCAL meter number</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00079">

This exception is generated when the import service imports a CFX file that contains a meter number that does not match the meter it is mapped to. The effective date of the exception can be used to identify the CFX file with the mismatched meter number.

This exception will not be generated for any manual import or for import formats other than CFX.

This exception can only be set to Acknowledged or Pending; it will not be resolved automatically or by the user.

The default severity is 0, which prevents the exception from generating.

</div>

</div>
